hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the roadway in the foreground.

hazards.name: Parked Car Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Continuous on-street parking on the right side obscures pedestrians from the view of oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Black trash bags are placed directly on the narrow sidewalk, forcing pedestrians to navigate around them or step into the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Center-right, on the sidewalk in front of the building entrance.

hazards.name: Narrow Walkway
hazards.description: The sidewalk is very narrow, providing insufficient space for two people to pass or for users with mobility aids, especially given the lack of a buffer.
hazards.location_in_image: Running along the base of the building.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: There is no planting strip or furniture zone separating the narrow walkway from the parking lane and travel lane.
hazards.location_in_image: Edge between the sidewalk and the roadway.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked cars
hazards.description: Continuous parallel parking on both sides of the street creates a visual barrier between the sidewalk and the roadway, making it difficult for drivers to see pedestrians, especially children, who might step into the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs throughout the foreground and mid-ground

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: Despite the residential nature and traffic calming, there are no marked crosswalks visible, which may lead to unsafe mid-block crossing behavior.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire visible roadway segment

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A large construction truck and trailer parked at the curb completely block sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground, spanning most of the curb line

hazards.name: Narrow pedestrian walkway
hazards.description: The sidewalk on the left is narrow and constrained by building facades, providing little room for pedestrians to pass one another comfortably.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image along the row houses

hazards.name: Construction equipment in roadway
hazards.description: An arrow board trailer is parked in the right-hand travel lane, narrowing the roadway and potentially causing erratic driver behavior.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway in the foreground

hazards.name: Uneven Sidewalk Pavement
hazards.description: Cracks and surface degradation on the sidewalk pose a trip hazard for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Sidewalk in front of the row houses and vacant lot.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian-Vehicle Separation
hazards.description: The absence of a buffer zone or parked cars leaves pedestrians exposed to moving traffic immediately adjacent to the curb.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line throughout the visible block.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Vegetation
hazards.description: Overgrown weeds and vegetation on the right-hand sidewalk reduce the effective walking width and create a tripping hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: Right-hand sidewalk in the mid-ground

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction (Trash)
hazards.description: A large pile of trash bags completely blocks a portion of the sidewalk, forcing pedestrians to step into the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground on the sidewalk

hazards.name: Degraded Sidewalk Surface
hazards.description: The sidewalk is heavily cracked with significant weed growth, creating tripping hazards and uneven surfaces.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the visible sidewalk area

hazards.name: Overgrown Vegetation
hazards.description: Dense brush and trees spill over the property line into the public right-of-way, obstructing sightlines and potential walking paths.
hazards.location_in_image: Center background, occupying the vacant lot

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars and trucks block the view between the roadway and the pedestrian area, increasing the risk of collisions.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground and midground

hazards.name: Narrow and Obstructed Sidewalks
hazards.description: Sidewalks are very narrow and partially obstructed by utility poles and overgrown vegetation, limiting pedestrian mobility.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the street

hazards.name: Poor Sidewalk Condition
hazards.description: Cracked pavement and heavy weed growth on the sidewalk create tripping hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side sidewalk

hazards.name: Lack of Street Lighting
hazards.description: No street lighting is visible in the immediate vicinity, which may reduce pedestrian safety and security at night.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the visible streetscape

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway at the intersection increases the exposure time for pedestrians crossing the street.
hazards.location_in_image: At the marked crosswalk in the background intersection.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Degradation
hazards.description: Cracks and vegetation growth in the sidewalk joints create uneven surfaces and potential tripping hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground sidewalk panels.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the ends of the block to improve visibility and shorten the crossing distance.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Install speed humps or cushions to physically slow traffic in this residential zone.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near potential crossing points to improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Install street trees or large planters to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the street.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Add street trees or a furniture zone to create a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Pave the missing section of the walkway to ensure a continuous and accessible path for all users.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lamps to enhance visibility and personal security for pedestrians at night.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Mark mid-block or intersection crossings with high-visibility paint to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Add street trees or planters where space allows to provide a physical buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway and to encourage slower driving speeds.

interventions.title: New Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a paved sidewalk on the left side of the street to complete the pedestrian network and provide a safe, accessible path.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions and Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at intersections to improve visibility and shorten the crossing distance, accompanied by high-visibility marked crosswalks.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Increase the width of the sidewalk to meet accessibility standards and provide a more comfortable walking environment.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furnishings
interventions.description: Implement a furniture zone with street trees or bollards to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and vehicles.

interventions.title: Designated Waste Collection Areas
interventions.description: Provide specific off-sidewalk locations for trash collection to prevent obstructions of the pedestrian clear path.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at potential crossing points to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility by moving pedestrians past the line of parked cars.

interventions.title: Marked Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: If pedestrian demand warrants, install a high-visibility marked crossing with appropriate signage.

interventions.title: Speed Humps or Cushions
interventions.description: Implement vertical speed control measures to reduce vehicle speeds on this straight residential stretch.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Vegetation
interventions.description: Introduce street trees or planters in a dedicated furniture zone to provide a buffer between pedestrians and parked cars and improve the microclimate.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to ensure the sidewalk and roadway are well-lit for nighttime safety.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repair and level the sidewalk surface to eliminate trip hazards and improve accessibility for all users.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Planting street trees would provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway while also encouraging slower driving speeds.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Maintenance
interventions.description: Resurface the sidewalk to provide a smooth, ADA-compliant walking surface free of cracks and vegetation.

interventions.title: Improved Waste Management
interventions.description: Implement regular sanitation services or provide designated waste containers to prevent trash from obstructing the pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant paved sidewalk along the entire block to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Clear and maintain the overgrowth on the vacant lot to restore sightlines and usable public space.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during evening hours.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Repair
interventions.description: Reconstruct and widen sidewalks to meet accessibility standards and remove tripping hazards from cracks and vegetation.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Green Infrastructure
interventions.description: Incorporate street trees or planters to create a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and moving traffic.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Introduce street trees or a planting buffer between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical separation from traffic and improve the walking environment.

interventions.title: Daylighting at Intersections
interventions.description: While not an intersection, ensuring parking is restricted near any potential crossing points would improve visibility currently blocked by parked cars.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalks to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Upgrade the standard transverse crosswalk markings to high-visibility continental or ladder patterns.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage if pedestrian volumes warrant a crossing here.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Repair cracked concrete panels and remove weeds to ensure a smooth, accessible walking surface.
